reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
Passenger safety comes first. I know how stressful the FAA’s nationwide ground stop is for Mainers traveling tonight and for families waiting to hear from loved ones.

The White House and FAA need to tell the public and Congress what happened and what they’re doing to fix it. 

We have yet to hear directly from President Trump.

Travelers need clear guidance on what to do now and when they can expect the next update.

I’m closely monitoring the FAA’s nationwide ground stop, and my office is gathering information as the situation develops.

I know this is unsettling, especially if you or a loved one is traveling. Passenger safety comes first, and we’ll share updates as we learn more.

Burgum also says Interior will stop using the Land and Water Conservation Fund to acquire federal public lands. Congress has already directed Interior to use some of that money to acquire land for national parks, wildlife refuges, and other public lands. That’s how we protect the

Donald Trump is treating America’s public lands like his personal real estate portfolio. And Doug Burgum just put the sell-off in writing.

The Interior Department’s new five-year plan calls for selling federal lands to states, local governments, and tribes.

Which lands? How https://t.co/DCWvbtyIO1

Pete Hegseth is the worst Secretary of Defense this country has ever had. Today, he dismissed the effort to impeach him as a “political spectacle,” but Congress has a duty to hold this administration accountable. 

The eight articles of impeachment were introduced by @RepThomasMassie, a member of his own party. They lay out the case for why Hegseth’s conduct amounts to high crimes and misdemeanors and why he should be removed from office.

Every single one of the impeachment articles is credible, well-founded, and rooted in facts. I will be voting in favor of impeachment.

I’d always rather be in Maine, but after way too long of a “Hegseth Holiday,” I’m ready to get back to Washington and back to work.

We’ll have a HUGE Democratic majority in January. And we have a long to-do list.

Ending Trump’s illegal war in Iran. Reversing the cuts to Medicaid and SNAP. Ending his reckless tariffs. Investigating this administration’s historic, rampant corruption.

But first, we need to pass a government funding bill. And we could vote as soon as this week to impeach Pete Hegseth for his stunning incompetence, disastrous handling of the war, and mistreatment of our servicemembers.

Let’s get it done!

A quick update from a rainy Maine greenhouse before I head back to Washington. 

It remains to be seen how outgoing Republicans will handle their losses, but we have work to do, including passing a government funding bill by Dec. 10. 

And fortunately, Dems don’t have to wait until January to get to work on holding this administration accountable. @RepThomasMassie will likely force a vote to impeach Pete Hegseth.

Busy week ahead. But feeling as hopeful and as motivated as ever!
So you agree? Presidents shouldn’t be able to destroy the White House? https://t.co/p2ZwVpYuLb https://t.co/Vva5HTjOgb

MAHA moms helped elect Donald Trump. His administration has repeatedly betrayed the movement they helped build.

Backing Bayer at the Supreme Court.

Invoking the Defense Production Act to boost glyphosate production.

Failing to act on PFAS contamination.

The list goes on. https://t.co/pIzYBNl5av

Donald Trump’s priorities are completely out of whack. And Republicans in Congress have enabled him every step of the way. 

The sun is setting on the Republican majority. And I’m taking that rainbow behind me as a sign of hope. https://t.co/rEhxAqNwfh
Who's gonna tell him? https://t.co/PTXZSLLpZi

This morning, my Portland office received a suspicious letter consistent with those received by many other congressional and election offices in recent days. I am grateful to the Portland Police and Fire Departments and the FBI for responding quickly to the potential threat and helping keep my staff and others in the Marine Trade Center safe. U.S. Capitol Police has been notified.

We cannot accept threats and intimidation as a normal part of our politics. The people who work in congressional offices and administer our elections are public servants dedicated to helping their communities. They deserve to do that work without fear. Political disagreement is part of a healthy democracy. Threatening the people who keep it running is unacceptable.

My team and I will not be deterred from our work. We will continue showing up for the people of Maine.

Just last month, 348 members of Congress, myself included, voted to impose new sanctions on Russia. Trump just waived them with the stroke of a pen.

First his diesel “deal.” Now this. He keeps handing Putin economic lifelines and pumping billions into his war chest. (And don’t https://t.co/W7kQvvmuda

After years of this man’s insane ramblings, depravity, and one outrageous, illegal action after another, it’s rare that anything he does still shocks me.

But this is truly batshit.

Congress JUST passed these sanctions last month (with bipartisan support!) to stand with Ukraine and choke off funding for Putin’s war machine. Now Trump is “exempting” Russia from them.

He’s handing Putin an economic lifeline to cover for the energy crisis his own disastrous war in Iran helped create, betraying Ukraine and our European allies in the process.
Is the president actually a Russian asset? Because he sure as hell acts like one. https://t.co/UJUvhtbtkV

We know Trump admires Putin. We know his diesel “deal” puts money in Putin’s war chest. But this Reuters report takes his betrayal to a whole new level.

Reuters reports the order to restrict the satellite system Ukraine uses to defend itself against Russia CAME FROM INSIDE THE WHITE HOUSE.

Trump is actively realigning American policy to side with Russia instead of our allies. It is a betrayal to Ukrainians, to Europe, and to Americans. Disrupting Ukrainian operations in favor of Putin puts blood on our hands.

Putin couldn’t ask for a better accomplice.
Republicans seeing today’s inflation news and being forced to confront the consequences of their blind support for Trump’s policies https://t.co/kS6yDGitlJ

I've been fighting for a food system that puts people and farmers first long before the "MAHA" movement.

But the moms and activists behind MAHA have helped bring these issues into the national spotlight, and that momentum is turning long-running fights into real bipartisan wins in Congress.

A few weeks ago, I joined @RepThomasMassie at @realorganicproj to talk about some of those fights (and wins!) and where we go from here.

We have to keep pushing, keep reaching across the aisle, and keep building on the issues that unite us.

Trump is using your tax dollars to run propaganda ads praising himself while his illegal war drives up the cost of gas and heating oil.

Corruption. Warmongering. Self-enrichment.

Republicans in Congress need to grow a spine, rein this president in, and do their jobs.

Enough already.

Thank you to @SteveCollinsSJ for this thoughtful (and very generous) column.

The stakes of this moment are much bigger than any one elected official. What matters is that we keep paying attention, speaking plainly, and turning justified frustration into action.

I’m grateful to the Mainers doing exactly that every day. I’ll keep doing my part, too.
https://t.co/PWwhYCLSeL
"The greatest economy in the history of our country by far," he said literally 2 days ago. https://t.co/s9mbWzxHpM https://t.co/D21utZmZg8

Over and over again, we’ve seen
@DHSgov agents resort to deadly violence when conducting enforcement operations in our districts. And when we demand to see the body cam footage, they give us the same tired excuses. 

NO MORE.  

The fact that DHS has failed to outfit its officers with body cameras—despite having hundreds of billions of dollars at its disposal and more than a year to procure and deploy this equipment—is totally unacceptable.  

There is simply NO reason that a federal agency with more money than most countries’ entire GDPs is not held to the same standards as local law enforcement.  

We deserve the truth about why cameras weren’t deployed during these most recent shootings, including the one that took the life of my constituent, Johan Sebastián Durán Guerrero, in Biddeford, Maine on July 13.

@RepSylviaGarcia, @RepCasar, and my demands are simple: Every immigration enforcement officer must have a working body camera, must be properly trained on how to use it, and be held accountable when that camera isn’t used.

NEW: @SenJeffMerkley + I are leading an effort in both the House and the Senate to prevent ANY president from demolishing a presidential memorial like the Kennedy Center. 

Our bipartisan Protecting Presidential Memorials Act establishes a simple safeguard: if Congress created the designation, only an act of Congress can authorize its demolition.

These monuments don’t belong to whoever’s sitting in the Oval Office. They belong to the American people.

Let’s be clear: It is ILLEGAL to pay for campaign ads with taxpayer money. Period.

There's a whole bunch of federal laws specifically designed to prevent the executive branch from using the machinery of government for partisan campaigning.

The seething, sinister vibes are just as alarming. He really does see himself as above silly things like “the law” and “campaign ethics.”

He’s also just flat-out desperate. He knows the American people are pissed, that his approval rating is lower than it’s ever been, and that Republicans are about to “find out” just how unpopular their reckless and destructive policies really are.

Add this to the long list of flagrantly illegal activity Democrats will be investigating.

Trump says he wants to help American farmers but then plans to flood the American market with foreign beef.

There is nothing “America First” about his dumbass plan. https://t.co/4TwQgBFjBG

Amazing how quickly Republicans’ tune changes when they actually have to answer to their angry constituents. 

Trump’s war in Iran? Too costly.

Sweeping immigration crackdown? Gone too far.

Naming memorials after himself? Not right.

@SpeakerJohnson, enough hiding from the voters. Bring the House back to Washington. 

If Republicans really mean what they’re saying back home, give them the chance to prove it with their votes.
So, JD Vance is a national security threat. Got it. https://t.co/iclM4GMmcV

I *should* be in Washington this week but, per usual, Republicans sent everyone home early. They’ve canceled 63 DAYS OF SESSION this Congress. 

Why? Could it be… 

The Epstein files discharge petition 2.0? 

The articles of impeachment @RepThomasMassie introduced against Hegseth? 

Or that they know they can’t get anything of significance done to help working Americans and lower costs?

🎯 🎯 🎯

I thought he couldn’t get lower than trying to rename the Kennedy Center. Now, Trump has his sights set on Ford’s Theatre? 

What is this obsession with trying to overshadow assassinated presidents? 

It’s absurd—and would defile a historic site.

Is the supposed “Party of Lincoln” going to stand for this?

ICE shot Alex Pretti in the back. A few days ago, they shot Wilber Rafael Garces Perez in the back. 

Wilber remains in custody with the bullet still lodged near his spine. DHS is still trying to deport him. 

ALL of these shootings demand full, independent investigations. 

Justice for Johan. Alex. Renée. Ruben. Lorenzo. Wilber. And the countless others whose lives have been destroyed by ICE—while their families were left to pick up the pieces.

When an ICE agent kills someone, they’re not just taking one life. They’re destroying a family and community.

Attorney Sean Murphy, who represents the family of Johan Sebastián Durán Guerrero, delivered incredibly powerful testimony today during @OversightDems hearing on ICE killings. 

Please watch this and listen to every word.

This is the President of the United States casually threatening to "annihilate" another country in front of the entire UN General Assembly.

What he’s saying would constitute war crimes. And this man has the nuclear codes. 

It’s astounding how hellbent he is on violating domestic and international law practically every time he opens his mouth. 

American foreign policy cannot revolve around destabilizing global peace and stability, the world economy, and our role as the leader of the free world. 

Horrifying.

Are Republicans really going to continue to sit back and allow this egomaniac to try and buy and bully his way to fabricated glory? 

Where is the outrage? 

Congress has the power to stop this madness; they won’t do it. SHAME. 

#kennedycenter https://t.co/jpdeQXxl8s

Trump says the Kennedy Center is bankrupt and that only he can save it. BULLSHIT. 

The only problem with the Kennedy Center is Donald J. Trump. https://t.co/lTJUCx9O9k

SOON: I’ll be joining @andersoncooper on @CNN to talk about Trump’s Kennedy Center takeover and his threats to demolish the living memorial to JFK. 

Tune in! https://t.co/BW402hLUQa

Despite being one of the fastest-growing waste streams in the US, there is NO coordinated effort at the federal level to combat fast fashion-driven waste.

That's why I'm introducing the Textile Waste Reduction Act (TWRA), a first-of-its-kind bill that would create a concrete and coherent federal strategy to reduce textile waste and build a more circular textile economy.

We have the resources and know-how to lead this effort on a global scale. It’s well past time we turn that potential into action—and help transform this wasteful industry into one that’s more efficient, more sustainable, and better for people and the planet.

Read more in @TeenVogue 👇

Trump’s USDA is flooding our markets with 600 million pounds of cut-rate foreign beef—a short-term stunt that could drive more American farmers out of business.

My friend and fellow farmer @RepThomasMassie and I have a real, bipartisan solution that delivers for American farmers and consumers: the PRIME Act.

It’s a lovely morning in DC and a great time for a stroll through the beautiful Lafayette Park.

Oh wait, I can’t get in without a special pass or an appointment! And Trump wants to make this fence *permanent*! 

Worst of all, the renovations (which actually look very nice) were stolen from NPS entrance fees. 

A public park, renovated with public money—and off limits to the public.

Ridiculous.
